column3: BSB recasts the verse as a comparison (“As … so”), and “dead flies” renders “flies of death”; the verb “ferments” is not rendered.
BSB adds “inclines”; the Hebrew has “is to his right … to his left.”
BSB renders “heart” as “sense” and “he says to everyone, he is a fool” as “he shows everyone that he is a fool.”
BSB renders “spirit” as “temper” and “place” as “post.”
Close to the Hebrew.
BSB renders “is put in many high places” as “is appointed to great heights.”
BSB renders “walk like slaves on the ground” as “go on foot like slaves.”
BSB adds “may” to both clauses; the Hebrew says “he will fall” and “a snake will bite him.”
Close to the Hebrew.
BSB renders “he has not sharpened the face” as “the blade unsharpened,” and “wisdom is an advantage to give success” as “skill produces success”; the meaning is uncertain.
BSB renders “the master of the tongue” as “the charmer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “consume” renders “swallow.”
Close to the Hebrew; “talk” and “speech” render “the words of his mouth” and “his mouth.”
BSB renders “the person does not know” as “no one knows.”
BSB reads “a fool” (singular) for “fools”; “the way to the city” renders “to walk to a city.”
BSB renders “eat in the morning” as “feast in the morning.”
BSB renders “eat” as “feast” and “drinking” as “drunkenness.”
BSB renders “the rafters sink” as “the roof caves in” and “lowering of hands” as “the hands of the idle.”
BSB renders “money answers everything” as “money is the answer for everything,” adding “but.”
BSB renders “mind” as “thoughts,” “chambers of lying down” as “bedroom,” and “the sound” and “the matter” as “your words” and “your speech.”
